findings.highlight: "Hi, Sakura. I heard you're a daughter of the Makiris, but I won't hold that against you. You seem like you know Shirou, so I'll give you special treatment."
findings.evidenceJa: 「よろしくサクラ。マキリの娘だそうだけど、軽蔑はしないであげるわ。いちおうシロウの知り合いみたいだし、特別に人間扱いしてあげる」
findings.governingReading: Illya grants Sakura the supposed exception of being treated as human because she knows Shirou.
findings.explanation: Illya's offer to treat Sakura as human becomes unspecified special treatment. The English retains condescension but removes the precise insult that Sakura turns back on her.

findings.highlight: Illya leaves Tohsaka and walks to the living room.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは遠坂の後に付いて居間へ歩いていく。
findings.governingReading: After the terse greeting, Illya walks to the living room behind/following Tohsaka.
findings.explanation: Illya following after Rin becomes leaving Rin.

findings.highlight: Sakura was stunned, but she still ended up eating the food too.
findings.evidenceJa: ショックで打ちひしがれた桜は、それきりモクモクと料理を口に運ぶだけになった。
findings.governingReading: Crushed by Rin's superior cooking, Sakura says no more and wordlessly devotes herself to moving food into her mouth.
findings.explanation: Sakura silently continuing to eat after the shock becomes merely eating too.

findings.highlight: "Why is Illya being so gruff with her when it's their first time meeting? The Einzberns and Makiris must not get along."
findings.evidenceJa: 「イリヤ、桜とは初対面のくせになんであんなにつっかかるんだろう。やっぱりアインツベルンとマキリって仲が悪いのかな」
findings.governingReading: Shirou speculates that the Einzbern and Makiri families may be on bad terms.
findings.explanation: Shirou wondering whether family rivalry explains Illya becomes asserting it must.

findings.highlight: Since Tohsaka-senpai took care of us tonight, I'll make breakfast tomorrow morning. I'll cook the things you like for breakfast."
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜は遠坂先輩にご馳走してもらいましたから、明日の朝はわたしが受け持ちますね。先輩仕込みの朝食で仕返ししてあげちゃいます」
findings.governingReading: Sakura proposes playful retaliation against Rin through a breakfast made using what Shirou taught her. Her mischievous grin and their subsequent talk of striking back confirm the competitive framing.
findings.explanation: Sakura's promise to strike back at Rin with Shirou-taught cooking becomes a promise to make his favorites. Her grin and the following mock battle talk remain, but their setup is missing.
